notes.title: The final update of the game.
notes.content:
Hello, guys!
A native English speaker has completely finished proofreading the script. 
Fixed typos, errors, and inaccuracies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38586722/8af35260c92c3b330b448a3a7af2c4dcb0111e7d.png
Enjoy the game!

If you notice a typo or error, please contact us. Twitter 
lotosprojectgame@gmail.com

We'll fix it immediately. 
Thanks.
